summary: Iteration 4 testing: Vimshottari Dasha + D9 Navamsa + Dosha Detection (Mangal/KaalSarp/SadeSati) + AI Hybrid Layer (Claude via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) + Daily Insights. Backend 13/13 pytest PASSED (100%). Frontend e2e flow PASSED: GrahaKundliPage shows DashaInfluenceCard (MD=Saturn, AD=Venus with 5 domain-impact pills + AI व्याख्या), DoshaPanel (Mangal HIGH/उच्च, Kaal Sarp absent, Sade Sati absent, AI-on-click works), D1+D9 SVG charts, Hi/En language toggle works correctly, Dashboard shows DashaInfluenceCard below DailyUpayaCard.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: dasha_engine.py is deterministic, well-commented, uses standard 120-yr Vimshottari cycle with accurate fractional-year math (365.2425).
Good: dosha_engine.py Mangal detection uses triple reference (Lagna+Moon+Venus) per classical rules; severity bucketing (HIGH=7,8 / MEDIUM=1,4,12 / LOW=2) is correct.

Good: ai_interpreter.py enforces strict system prompt with 'no hallucination' rule. Verified in UI: AI explanation references ONLY structured data (Saturn MD, Venus AD, 8th-from-Lagna Mars) — no new predictions.
Good: AI explanations cached per-language under ai_cache field; verified cached=True on 2nd call.
Concern: server.py has grown to 5087 lines. Strongly recommend splitting /api/dasha, /api/dosha, /api/charts, /api/insights, /api/kundli into separate routers (exceeds 700-line rule by ~7x).
Concern: /api/dasha/current recomputes interpretation on-fly if missing, but doesn't persist updated_at in ISO-8601 consistently — minor, non-blocking.
Nit: dosha_engine.detect_sade_sati returns inconsistent field set — Shani Dhaiya path returns different keys than regular Sade Sati path. Frontend may need defensive access.
Nit: /api/auth/admin/login response uses access_token; confirm consistency with other flows (some code paths reference 'token').
seed_data_creation: Kundli regenerated for Test User Male 1990-08-15 10:30 Delhi India. Verified: MD=Saturn (2016-2035), AD=Venus (2023-2026), Mangal Dosha present HIGH (Mars 8th from Lagna, 12th from Moon), Kaal Sarp absent (4/7 distribution), Sade Sati absent (Saturn in मेष, natal Moon in मिथुन).

context_for_next_testing_agent: All Dasha/Dosha/D9/AI features end-to-end working. Tests use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var — pytest must be run with it exported. AI calls (Claude via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) take ~3-6s first call, cached thereafter. Test fixture (1990-08-15 10:30 Delhi Male) deterministically yields Saturn MD + Venus AD + Mangal Dosha HIGH. Admin login endpoint is /api/auth/admin/login returning access_token. AI interpretations are safely rule-bound — no prediction hallucination observed.
